name: ai_video
description: AI-generated video: director agent writes a storyboard from your prompt and references, you review and approve, then scenes are generated via Kling.

steps.note: Skill ai-video-plan (Phases 0-2). The storyboard is pre-seeded; tracks[0] stays empty until generation.
steps.description: Director skill. Story clarification, storyboard writes (scenes, imageRefs, styleAnchor), approval gate.
Per styleRef: Gemini extracts mood/style text. Director folds outputs into storyboard.styleAnchor.
Per imageRef: generate a reference image from the user's anchor text. Director skips entries where source != 'text' or refImages is already populated.

steps.note: Skill ai-video-generate (Phases 6-7). Never load it or call kling_generate before storyboard.approval is set.
steps.description: Generation orchestration. Dispatch mode selection, scene generation via kling_generate, audio assembly. Runs after storyboard approval.

steps.note: Append-only to tracks[0]: real clips, no stubs. Set status draft only when every scene has a clip (or batchShots entry).
steps.description: Per scene (post-approval only): Kling generates the clip. Appends result to tracks[0]. May be batched (multi-shot): up to 6 scenes per call.
Per scene (post-generation, optional): evaluates clips via analyze_media (Gemini rubric). Failures are regenerated via kling_generate.

agent_notes: Director-driven: the agent writes the storyboard from the prompt and references, the user approves it, and only then are scenes generated.
The agent's own tools (media analysis, image generation, video generation) are invoked from within those two flows.
